content.json:
# Documentation Overview

Monthly review. Work top to bottom: zero-result searches first, then negative feedback, then completion, then traffic.

See `docs/analytics/README.md` in the UI repo for what to do with each result.

content.query:
// THE actionable query. Every row is something a reader expected to find and
// could not — each is a documentation task, and some are feature requests.
// Returns no rows until docs search ships (phase 2b).
customEvents
| where name == "Docs_Search"
| where timestamp > ago(30d)
| extend query = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(customDimensions.query))),
         resultCount = toint(customDimensions.resultCount)
| where isnotempty(query)
| where resultCount == 0
| summarize searches = count(),
            people = dcount(user_Id),
            lastSeen = max(timestamp)
        by query
| order by searches desc, people desc
content.title: Zero-result searches - read this one first

content.query:
// Pages readers explicitly marked unhelpful, worst ratio first.
// minVotes keeps a single grumpy vote from topping the list; lower it if the
// docs are quiet, raise it once volume grows.
let minVotes = 5;
customEvents
| where name == "Docs_Feedback"
| where timestamp > ago(90d)
| extend slug = tostring(customDimensions.slug),
         helpful = tobool(customDimensions.helpful)
| summarize votes = count(),
            unhelpful = countif(helpful == false)
        by slug
| where votes >= minVotes
| extend unhelpfulPct = round(100.0 * unhelpful / votes, 1)
| order by unhelpfulPct desc, votes desc
content.title: Pages marked unhelpful

content.query:
// The free text behind the votes. Read this alongside negative-feedback.kql —
// the ratio says which page is failing, these say why.
customEvents
| where name == "Docs_Feedback"
| where timestamp > ago(90d)
| extend slug = tostring(customDimensions.slug),
         helpful = tobool(customDimensions.helpful),
         comment = tostring(customDimensions.comment)
| where isnotempty(comment)
| project timestamp, slug, helpful, comment
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Feedback comments

content.query:
// How far readers actually get. A low completion rate on a long page usually
// means it should be split rather than rewritten.
let views =
    customEvents
    | where name == "Docs_PageView" and timestamp > ago(30d)
    | extend slug = tostring(customDimensions.slug)
    | summarize views = count() by slug;
let depth =
    customEvents
    | where name == "Docs_ScrollDepth" and timestamp > ago(30d)
    | extend slug = tostring(customDimensions.slug),
             bucket = toint(customDimensions.bucket)
    | summarize reached50 = countif(bucket == 50),
                reached100 = countif(bucket == 100)
            by slug;
views
| join kind=leftouter depth on slug
| extend halfPct = round(100.0 * coalesce(reached50, 0) / views, 1),
         completedPct = round(100.0 * coalesce(reached100, 0) / views, 1)
| project slug, views, halfPct, completedPct
| order by views desc
content.title: Scroll completion by page
